vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 4.2.0

The skill provides a legitimate interface for an AI agent to access news and web search results via the agenttimes.live API. It uses standard curl commands to interact with documented endpoints and includes helpful instructions for the agent without any evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: An instruction-only news search skill that is internally consistent with its description: it only requires curl and calls the agenttimes.live HTTP endpoints; it does not request unrelated credentials or install code.

dimensions.detail: The name/description claim a news/search API; the SKILL.md shows only HTTP GET/POST usage against agenttimes.live and requires only curl. Required binaries and declared capabilities align with a news search skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to calling agenttimes.live endpoints (search, trending, stats, subscribe). One noteworthy element: the /subscribe endpoint asks for a webhook URL you control — subscribing will cause the service to POST to that URL. The SKILL.md does not instruct the agent to read local files or environment variables, nor to transmit agent/system data, but users should avoid supplying webhook URLs that could unintentionally capture sensitive data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files. This is lowest-risk: nothing is written to disk by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables or credentials. That is proportionate for a public HTTP API with free endpoints. (Paid/bulk features are referenced but no credentials/payment instructions are required by the skill.)
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (no forced persistence). The skill is user-invocable and can be called autonomously per platform defaults; nothing else requests elevated or permanent privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and appears coherent for news/search use. Before installing or using it: (1) trust the remote service (agenttimes.live) because your agent will send HTTP queries to it; (2) be careful when using /subscribe—don’t provide webhook URLs that accept or expose sensitive agent or system data; (3) understand paid/bulk functionality (micropayments on Base) likely requires separate payment/auth steps not included here; and (4) avoid pasting secrets or private endpoints into queries or webhook fields.
